Remove %1$s
%1$s will disappear from the home screen straight away. Nothing is deleted: if you add it again with \"Add a hidden app\", your things in it will still be there.

Until this works, nothing changes: you still look after this phone, with the same PIN, waits and limits. Calls, texts and Emergency work.
Until this is fixed, we can\'t say whose Google account a wipe would ask for.
